details:
- CVE-2025-1371: fix null pointer dereference in eu-readelf when processing
  corrupt ELF files with broken program headers
- CVE-2025-1376: fix denial of service in libelf when processing sections
  without data (elf_strptr on sections with sh_size set but no data)
- CVE-2025-1377: fix denial of service in eu-strip when processing relocation
  tables with invalid symbol table sections (SHT_NOBITS)
